pattern_id: # Per-game audit trail - one row per game in PREDS.csv
# pattern_id: unique game identifier from input
# home_implied_prob_open: implied P(Home wins) from opening line
# home_implied_prob_close: implied P(Home wins) from closing line
# y_hat: model prediction at default 0.5 cut
# bet_placed: True if this game passed bet_mode filters
# bet_side: 'Home' or 'Vis' - which side was bet (matches y_hat)
# bet_was_fave: True if the side bet on had the more negative ML
# price_used: the moneyline used for payout calculation (controlled by price_source config)
# stake: USD risked on this bet. Per American moneyline convention: stake = unit_size * abs(ML)/100 for favourites (ML<0); stake = unit_size for dogs (ML>0). Varies per bet
# profit: USD profit. On a win: profit = unit_size (fave) or unit_size * ML/100 (dog). On a loss: profit = -stake
# return_: USD returned (stake + profit on win; 0 on loss)
